overview: Euclid DR1 dominates with two strong-lens papers: a transformer-CNN segmentation pipeline and a CNN ablation/ensemble yielding 11,256 grade A/B candidates. Other work applies ML to cluster mass maps, LSST Y1 Galileon emulation, FLAMINGO catalogue augmentation, unsupervised FRB/galaxy classification, and symbolic regression for Roche lobe radii.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
Unsupervised classification of transients and galaxies
